description: The outbound actions in an outbound whisper flow, each typed sub-block with its branches: compare on a JSONPath choosing complete_outbound_call, whose caller_id is an object holding a static number and which has no error block, or the same type carrying VoiceConnector and ConnectionTimeLimitSeconds, written as a generic block (owner decision 4); check_outbound_call_status with no attributes, four Equals conditions on the page's statuses in its order and the catch-all; message_participant twice; start_outbound_chat_contact twice, once with source_endpoint.address a phonenumber reference key, contact_flow_arn a flow reference key, a JSONPath destination, an initial_system_message object and related_contact, and once with the source and flow as JSONPaths and a static E.164 destination, each with its catch-all; and end_flow_execution. Position blocks on the four actions off the default layout. Refs: the phonenumber and the flow, each bound to an address. Awaits the provider release that carries these blocks (tasks/D10), so it has no validate directory yet.
